Theme of dynamic spectrograms

Source: R/dynaspec.R
ds_theme.Rd

ds_theme() sets the look of a dynaspec() object (axes, text, panels, colors and player controls), in the same way for all styles. Adding it again changes the settings supplied (other settings are kept). Preset themes (e.g. ds_theme_dark()) set several settings at once.

Usage

ds_theme(
  xlab,
  ylab,
  cex.lab,
  cex.axis,
  font.lab,
  col.lab,
  col.axis,
  axis.type,
  bg,
  family,
  las,
  tick.length,
  box,
  col.box,
  grid,
  col.grid,
  col.panel,
  col.title,
  cex.title,
  pal,
  colbg,
  col.wave,
  col.line,
  lty.line,
  lwd.line,
  col.highlight,
  col.annotation,
  col.bar,
  bg.bar,
  bar.style
)

ds_theme_dark(...)

ds_theme_presentation(...)

ds_theme_paper(...)

ds_theme_minimal(...)

ds_theme_transparent(...)

ds_theme_void(...)

ds_theme_macaulay(...)

ds_theme_xenocanto(...)

ds_theme_mako(...)

Arguments

xlab, ylab

Titles of the time and frequency axes. Defaults are "Time (s)" and "Frequency (kHz)".

cex.lab, cex.axis

Size of axis titles and axis labels, relative to the style default (e.g. 1.5 is 50% larger). Defaults are 1 (1.2 for axis titles of static spectrograms).

font.lab

Font of axis titles: 1 (plain), 2 (bold), 3 (italic) or 4 (bold italic). Defaults are 1 (static and scrolling) and 2 (paged).

col.lab

Color of axes, axis labels and titles. Default is black (paged spectrograms: picked to contrast with the background).

col.axis

Color of the axis labels (tick labels), when they should differ from the axis titles and lines. Default is 'col.lab'.

axis.type

Character string: "standard" (axes with labels and titles), "inside" (no axis titles; frequency labels inside the spectrogram, e.g. "8k", and time labels below the lowest panel, e.g. "2s"), "compact" (no axis titles; frequency labels below short ticks in a narrow column on the left, with the unit at the bottom, and time labels in minutes and seconds, e.g. "0:02", above the figure), "minimal" (1 s and 1 kHz scale bars; scrolling spectrograms only) or "none" (no axes). Defaults are "standard" (static and scrolling) and "none" (paged).

bg

Background color of the figure around the panels ("transparent" for a transparent background). Default is white. The backgrounds of the panels are set separately: 'colbg' (spectrograms, see ds_spectrogram()) and 'col.panel' (other panels).

family

Font family of all text, including captions and annotation labels: "sans", "serif", "mono" or the name of a font installed in the system. Default is "sans".

las

Orientation of the axis labels (tick labels), as in graphics::par(): 0 (parallel to the axis), 1 (horizontal), 2 (perpendicular to the axis) or 3 (vertical). Applies to both axes (e.g. 2 makes time labels vertical and frequency labels horizontal) with standard axes ('axis.type'). Defaults are 1 (static and paged: horizontal labels) and 0 (scrolling: vertical frequency labels).

tick.length

Length of axis ticks, in lines of text (0 hides ticks). Defaults are 0.5 (static and scrolling) and 0.3 (paged).

box

Logical argument to control whether boxes are drawn around panels. Default is TRUE.

col.box

Color of the boxes around panels. Default is 'col.lab'.

grid

Logical argument to control whether horizontal grid lines are drawn at the frequency axis ticks of spectrograms. Default is FALSE.

col.grid

Color of grid lines. Default is a translucent gray.

col.panel

Background color of oscillogram, envelope and power spectrum panels. Default is 'bg' (the figure background shows through).

col.title, cex.title

Color and size of titles (the title of paged spectrograms and the 'Amp.' label of power spectra). Defaults are 'col.lab' and 1.

pal, colbg

Color palette and background of spectrograms (see ds_spectrogram()). Used when not supplied in ds_spectrogram().

col.wave

Color of oscillograms, envelopes and power spectra. Used when not supplied in ds_oscillogram(), ds_envelope() or ds_spectrum().

col.line

Color of the play line (and cursor of paged spectrograms). Used when 'lcol' is not supplied in the style (ds_static(), ds_scrolling() or ds_paged()).

lty.line, lwd.line

Type and width of the play line of scrolling spectrograms. Used when 'lty' and 'lwd' are not supplied in ds_scrolling().

col.highlight

Color of the highlight box of paged spectrograms (used when 'highlight.col' is not supplied in ds_paged()) and of the translucent boxes dimming the parts of the ds_overview() outside the window shown in scrolling spectrograms. Default is gray in overviews.

col.annotation

Color of the boxes of ds_annotations(). Used when 'col' is not supplied in ds_annotations().

col.bar, bg.bar

Color of the text and background of the player controls of web pages (play button, sliders, ...). Defaults are dark gray and transparent (the page background).

bar.style

Style of the player controls of web pages: "standard" (rectangular buttons), "rounded" (round play button, rounded controls, a seek bar and a frame with rounded corners around the figure; 'bg.bar' is used as the background of the whole player) or "square" (flat bar with a square play button and sliders in the color of the play line). With "rounded" ds_player() shows the seek bar and the time by default (buttons = c("progress", "time")), and with "square" the volume control and the time (buttons = c("volume", "time")). Default is "standard".

...

Settings of ds_theme() that replace those of the preset theme.

Value

A layer to be added to a dynaspec() object with +.

Details

Only the settings supplied are used; other settings take the defaults of each style. Settings supplied in other layers (e.g. the palette in ds_spectrogram()) take precedence over those of the theme.

Preset themes are complete themes: adding one replaces previous themes (use ds_theme() afterwards to change some of its settings, or supply them in the preset):

  • ds_theme_dark(): black background, white text, 'mako' palette.

  • ds_theme_mako(): light theme with the 'mako' palette (reversed: light background and dark sounds) and 'mako' colors for panels, annotations, play line and player controls.

  • ds_theme_presentation(): large bold text for slides and projectors.

  • ds_theme_paper(): black and white with serif fonts, for printed figures.

  • ds_theme_minimal(): no boxes, light gray axes and short ticks.

  • ds_theme_transparent(): transparent background, to blend in slides or web pages of any color.

  • ds_theme_void(): no axes, titles or boxes (only the sound).

  • ds_theme_macaulay(): inspired by the player of the 'Macaulay Library': gray spectrogram, compact axes (time in minutes and seconds above the figure) and a black player bar with a square play button. Best with ds_scrolling() and an ds_overview() (e.g. ds_scrolling(t.display = 1.5, fix.time = FALSE)).

  • ds_theme_xenocanto(): inspired by the player of the 'Xeno-canto' web site: gray spectrogram, labels inside the figure, solid play line and rounded player controls with a seek bar. Best with ds_scrolling() and an ds_oscillogram() (e.g. ds_scrolling(t.display = 1.5, fix.time = FALSE)).

See also

ds_set_theme() to set a theme for all spectrograms, dynaspec(), ds_spectrogram()

Examples

data(scythebill)

x <- dynaspec(scythebill, flim = c(1.5, 5.5)) +
  ds_spectrogram(wl = 200, collevels = seq(-50, 0, 1)) +
  ds_theme(xlab = "Time (s)", ylab = "Frequency (kHz)", cex.lab = 1.4, font.lab = 2)

# preset theme with larger axis titles
x <- dynaspec(scythebill, flim = c(1.5, 5.5)) +
  ds_spectrogram(wl = 200, collevels = seq(-50, 0, 1)) + ds_oscillogram() +
  ds_theme_dark(cex.lab = 1.4)

# Macaulay Library look
data(antshrike)
x <- dynaspec(antshrike, flim = c(0.5, 5.5)) +
  ds_spectrogram(wl = 256, collevels = seq(-50, 0, 1)) +
  ds_overview() + ds_theme_macaulay() + ds_scrolling(t.display = 3, fix.time = FALSE)

# Xeno-canto look (and its color version)
x <- dynaspec(antshrike, flim = c(0.5, 5.5)) +
  ds_spectrogram(wl = 256, collevels = seq(-50, 0, 1)) + ds_oscillogram(height = 0.15) +
  ds_theme_xenocanto() + ds_scrolling(t.display = 3, fix.time = FALSE)
x <- x + ds_theme_xenocanto(pal = viridis::inferno, colbg = "black", bg = "black",
  col.panel = "black", col.wave = "white", col.lab = "white", col.line = "white")
